research_note: Incremental 13 Nov 2026, overlap 7–13 Nov: 1 newly discovered employer-listed UE5 Technical Artist lead (Crater Studios, Egypt remote eligibility unconfirmed), 0 existing materially changed, 0 newly closed, 2 existing employer vacancies rechecked (Aether Pixels and Crater gameplay engineer). Rotated Work With Indies, Ashby, Hitmarker, Egyptian job discovery, remote talent marketplace and employer XR/technical-art pages. Excluded closed indie roles, UK-only hybrid, LATAM-only and senior-only roles. No verified new Egypt-eligible junior gameplay position or vacancy-specific visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Unreal Engine Developer
jobs.experience: 0–1 year listed; no graduation-year rule stated
jobs.summary: Build interactive architectural and VR scenes with Unreal Engine, Blueprints, lighting, materials and optimisation.
jobs.why_fit: Omar's UE5, Blueprint, Maya, Blender and SketchUp work aligns closely. A realistic non-gaming entry into professional Unreal projects.
jobs.caveats: The original LinkedIn vacancy (9 months old) explicitly says it is no longer accepting applications. A third-party STJ listing remains visible without confirmation of an active opening. Enquire directly at ArtCreator before applying; treat this as a speculative follow-up, not a currently confirmed vacancy.

jobs.experience: 1+ year professional production OR equivalent relevant game-development projects
jobs.egypt_eligibility: Yes — employer says best candidate regardless of location, outside Ireland is contractor
jobs.visa_status: No relocation needed if contractor in Egypt; verify tax/contract terms
